_comment: Optional per-deployment branding, shared by the HOAST player landing page and the telemetry dashboard (:8090). Mount your filled copy at /brand.json (see docker-compose.override.yml.example). Every key is optional; when the file is absent both pages stay generic. Player text values are HTML.

_comment_telemetry: host and boxLinks brand the telemetry dashboard's launcher buttons. host is this deployment's reachable address (a Tailscale name or an IP); omit it and the buttons fall back to whatever address the dashboard was opened on. boxLinks overrides the built-in button list (label + port + path, all resolved on host); omit it to keep the defaults shown below. Do not use TEL_HOST for this: it is only a display label.
